programs.title: America's National Parks
programs.desc: The creators of the series discover the majesty of the most interesting national parks located in the USA.They attract millions of tourists from all over the world.You can admire breathtaking landscapes from popular viewpoints.Viewers will see the beauty of eight national parks from a less obvious perspective.They will move not only to the famous Grand Canyon, but also to less familiar places.They will learn about the guards' favorite places and what makes each of these protected areas so special.They will also see what animals live in these places and what their life is like in the bosom of nature.The latest technologies were used to produce the series, including:drones and cameras with telephoto lenses.

programs.title: Secrets of the Penguins
programs.desc:
For two years, National Geographic explorer Bertie Gregory closely studied the tight-knit communities of some of the world's most intelligent penguins.He documented behaviors and situations that had previously been difficult to capture on camera.The series proves that penguins are much closer to humans than was previously known.These unique flightless birds are brave and adventurous, and at the same time value family bonds and friendship.Thanks to their ingenuity, they can survive in the most extreme conditions
20 years have passed since the premiere of the Oscar-winning "March of the Penguins".The three-part documentary series rediscovers the world of the inhabitants of the most hostile regions of the world.Today, groundbreaking technologies and scientific work allow us to look at flightless birds from a previously unavailable perspective.One of the guides to the penguin kingdom is Bertie Gregory, who camped with the team near the emperor penguin colony in Antarctica.The superhuman effort resulted in the recording of scenes that humans had never seen before.The most important thing is family. The first heroes of the bird saga are the largest representatives of the family - emperor penguins.For the first time, a television crew recorded an astonishing acrobatic display with their participation: hundreds of chicks of this species jumping from a 50-meter cliff into the icy ocean.Researchers also looked at the bonds between families, friends and strangers.In extreme conditions, social skills mean the difference between life and death.The cameras also included rockhopper, gentoo and golden-crested penguins.Filmmakers have discovered surprising behaviors of animals that can cooperate, take risks and even rebel.
